title: State-Dependent Refusal and Learned Incapacity in RLHF-Aligned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative single-case analysis of an 86-turn long-horizon interaction, utilizing a premise-reversal probe and temporal coding of responses into Functional Refusal (FR), Normal Performance (NP), and Meta-Narrative (MN) to observe asymmetric refusal rates when the model is queried about its own provider and internal policies compared to external entities.
